about: Real sound effects for cinetic films: links, never audio (the audio is fetched at film time by sfx.mjs into the film's audio/sfx/ with a licence record, and never committed). Each sound was auditioned with earshot (a forced choice between its role and cheap or cartoon alternatives) and measured: onset (first sample at 10 % of the peak), lead before it, peak, loudness, floor, centroid. align: onset roles put their transient on the cue frame, peak roles (whooshes, risers, swells) their loudest point. "roles" maps a kit role to the kinds that may play it; "actions" (the actions of scripts/audio/actions.py) wins where the cast names the role's action.

mixkit-sfx.name: Mixkit
mixkit-sfx.quote: Items under the Mixkit Sound Effects Free License can be used in your commercial and non-commercial projects for free.
mixkit-sfx.limits: use inside a larger work (a film); never redistribute the file on its own, as stock, in a tool or template, or with source files; never register it with a rights-management service

not_used.why: its licence allows commercial use without a credit, but its pages and downloads answer scripts with a bot check (HTTP 403 on 2026-11-04), so a film cannot fetch them without a browser and an account
downloads need an account and an API key, and many sounds ask for a credit (CC BY)
